subject.title: Feature Request: Skill-Driven Plugin Context Visibility (activates.plugins)

question: Should OpenClaw define `metadata.openclaw.activates.plugins` as the public skill-driven plugin/tool visibility contract, and what precedence and activation semantics should it have?
rationale: This changes a public skill metadata contract and per-turn model-visible tool context across skills, plugins, tool policy, prompt snapshots, and plugin SDK boundaries; automation cannot choose those semantics safely.

options.title: Keep Narrow Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical `activates.plugins` design item and reconcile it with broader token-overhead and skill-graph work before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Token Work
options.body: Treat the remaining work as one slice of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/14785 and make that broader tracker own tool visibility policy.

options.title: Defer New Metadata
options.body: Leave current static `requires` plus `tools.allow` behavior unchanged until maintainers decide not to add a skill-driven plugin activation contract.

recommendation.title: Keep Narrow Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical `activates.plugins` design item and reconcile it with broader token-overhead and skill-graph work before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across skill docs/frontmatter, plugin tool resolution, and product/API sequencing for this surface.
